what: Book-spine shelf — hover a spine with a vertical title and its background brightens one tone over 400ms ease-out, press it and only that book opens sideways (width 0 → 75vh, .5s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1)). Press again to fold it. When opening ends, fx:resize fires so the horizontal scroll panel re-measures its length (the original then calls locomotive.update and scrollTo that book, offset −122).

options.single: When 1, opening one folds the other books in the same row (the original lets several open together)
options.--fx-spine-hover: Background when raised or unfolded (css variable), default --kf-surface

from.where: work.html .brand-item — original .book-wrap width 0 → 75vh transition .5s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), .brand-item:hover background 400ms ease-out
